Centerpiece is an Adidas FIFA World Cup football placed in front of a black branded box on a solid red studio background. Background is minimal and clean with strong brand color. Surrounding elements: top co-branding row with FIFA icon, Budweiser wordmark, and Quán Nhậu Tự Do logo; centered white title 'BÓNG ADIDAS' and 'FIFA WORLD CUP'; and bottom-right alcohol disclaimer with 18+ icons. Technical style: photorealistic product advertising photography, studio lighting, soft shadow and glossy packshot highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
